title: K0LearningAdvisoryV1
description: K0→K1 SSE event payload: P21 learning-loop advisory describing drift, regression, or improvement of a K0 pipeline algorithm. Consumed by the K1 planner/orchestrator to retune local strategies. Free-form ``details`` payload because the advisory shape varies per signal class; the producer guarantees ``signal_class`` selects the schema sub-shape.

envelope_id.description: Per-event ULID. Used as the SSE Last-Event-ID cursor token.

pipeline_id.description: Pipeline that generated the advisory (e.g. P02, P08).

details.description: Advisory-specific detail payload; the producer-side schema is governed by ``signal_class``.
